    x_ptr, w_ptr, b_ptr, y_ptr,
    B, F, D1, D2, N,
    stride_x_b, stride_x_f, stride_x_d1, stride_x_d2,
    stride_w_f, stride_w_d1, stride_w_d2,
    stride_y_b, stride_y_f, stride_y_d1, stride_y_d2,
    eps,
    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr, VEC: tl.constexpr

    pid_b = tl.program_id(0)
    # Early exit if pid_b >= B (safety if grid larger than B)
    if pid_b >= B:
        return

    b_i64 = pid_b.to(tl.int64)
    sx_b = stride_x_b
    sx_f = stride_x_f
    sx_d1 = stride_x_d1
    sx_d2 = stride_x_d2

    sw_f = stride_w_f
    sw_d1 = stride_w_d1
    sw_d2 = stride_w_d2

    sy_b = stride_y_b
    sy_f = stride_y_f
    sy_d1 = stride_y_d1
    sy_d2 = stride_y_d2

    base_y = b_i64 * sy_b

    r = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
    offset = 0
    m = tl.zeros([1], dtype=tl.float64)
    v = tl.zeros([1], dtype=tl.float64)
    # Fast path for contiguous layouts to avoid expensive div/mod index computations

        (sx_f == d1d2) & (sx_d1 == D2) & (sx_d2 == 1) &
        (sw_f == d1d2) & (sw_d1 == D2) & (sw_d2 == 1) &
        (sy_f == d1d2) & (sy_d1 == D2) & (sy_d2 == 1)
    )

        per_bs_elems = BLOCK_SIZE * VEC
        chunk = 4 * per_bs_elems
        c = tl.arange(0, VEC)
        while offset + chunk <= N:
            idx0 = offset + r[:, None] * VEC + c[None, :]
            idx1 = idx0 + per_bs_elems
            idx2 = idx1 + per_bs_elems
            idx3 = idx2 + per_bs_elems

            off_x1 = base_x + idx1.to(tl.int64)
            off_x2 = base_x + idx2.to(tl.int64)
            off_x3 = base_x + idx3.to(tl.int64)

            x1 = tl.load(x_ptr + off_x1)
            x2 = tl.load(x_ptr + off_x2)
